theme: 人海里遇见一个同频的人，到底有多难？
cover_lines: 人海里遇见一个同频的人
cover_en: How hard is it to find someone in tune?

captions.cn: 你已经遇见许多人，为什么还孤单？
captions.en: You've met so many. Why do you still feel alone?

captions.cn: 名字越存越多，心事却无处可放
captions.en: More names saved. Nowhere to leave your worries.

captions.cn: 有些话，打完又删
captions.en: Some words are typed, then erased.

captions.cn: 坐得很近，也可能相隔很远
captions.en: Close seats can still hold a great distance.

captions.cn: 连潮水，也有各自的时刻
captions.en: Even the tides keep their own time.

captions.cn: 同一片天空，各有各的去向
captions.en: One sky, so many different directions.

captions.cn: 同一座城，日子却很少交叠
captions.en: One city. Lives that barely overlap.

captions.cn: 擦肩很多，相遇很少
captions.en: So many crossings. So few encounters.

captions.cn: 所以，人多不等于有人懂你
captions.en: A crowd doesn't mean someone understands.

captions.cn: 合拍的人，究竟藏在哪里？
captions.en: Where are the people who feel in tune?

captions.cn: 相似，让我们更容易靠近
captions.en: Similarity can draw us closer.

captions.cn: 研究发现，相似的人更常相连
captions.en: Research finds that similar people connect more often.

captions.cn: 兴趣，让我们走向相近的地方
captions.en: Interests lead us toward similar places.

captions.cn: 生活，也悄悄圈定相遇的范围
captions.en: Daily life quietly shapes whom we meet.

captions.cn: 你遇见的，从来不是整个人海
captions.en: You never meet the whole sea of people.

captions.cn: 暂时没遇见，不等于你有问题
captions.en: Not meeting them yet doesn't mean you're flawed.

captions.cn: 去你真正在意的地方
captions.en: Go where the things you care about live.

captions.cn: 让一次相遇，有机会成为日常
captions.en: Give one encounter a chance to become familiar.

captions.cn: 然后，试着多说一句真心话
captions.en: Then try saying one more honest thing.

captions.cn: 相似，可以是开始
captions.en: Similarity can be a beginning.

captions.cn: 不同，也值得被听见
captions.en: Differences deserve to be heard, too.

captions.cn: 懂得，常从愿意听开始
captions.en: Understanding often begins with listening.

captions.cn: 不必每一步，都走得一样
captions.en: You don't have to take every step alike.

captions.cn: 合拍，是你愿意听我说完
captions.en: Being in tune means letting me finish.

captions.cn: 也是我，愿意向你再走一步
captions.en: And my willingness to take one step toward you.

sources.title: Birds of a Feather: Homophily in Social Networks
sources.supports: 相似性与社会网络中的连接有关；不支持命定相遇概率或保证相互理解。
